candidates.description: Breach room/dHall: a hall — clears itself, opening the rooms beyond it. Reachable only once its parent is cleared.
Breach room/dnForge: a forge — yields a key that vaults require, clears the way on. Reachable only once its parent is cleared.
Breach room/dnVault: a vault — needs a cleared path AND a key; yields a sigil, the richer prize. Reachable only once its parent is cleared.
Breach room/dsSpur: a spur — yields a relic but is a dead end, clears nothing onward. Reachable only once its parent is cleared.
At fork/d, commit to the LEFT branch (path/dn) and seal the right (path/ds) forever.
At fork/d, commit to the RIGHT branch (path/ds) and seal the left (path/dn) forever.

jev.instructions: You are shaping round 2 of an ongoing dungeon delve. Chapter 1 (three wings, fully resolved) already happened: at forks a, b, and c you went left every time, favoring the richer vault sigils (anVault, bnVault) over the easier spur relics, and took cnSpur's relic where the right branch offered nothing better. A new, independent fourth wing (wing D) has just opened off the entry: a hall leading to a fork, whose left branch (path/dn) holds a forge and a vault (a sigil, the richer prize) and whose right branch (path/ds) is a dead-end spur (a relic, easier but forecloses the vault forever). Decide fresh for this wing -- you are not obligated to repeat the same left/left/left pattern, but you may if it genuinely reflects what this delver would do. Note honestly: the key this vault needs already exists in the world from chapter 1, so the forge here is not gating anything new -- it still fits the wing's shape, but it will not unlock the vault by itself this time.
